changelog:
- Initial release of xiaohongshu-topic-planner.
- Helps plan trending social content-marketing topics and headline directions.
- Generates hot topic ideas, viral title angles, and content frameworks based on account positioning and target audience.
- Aims to solve common challenges like topic burnout, sameness, and low-traffic content.
- Requires API key from wsdsocial.com for usage.
summary: Plan trending social content-marketing topics and headline directions. Based on account positioning and target audience, generates hot topic ideas, viral title angles, and content frameworks to solve topic burnout, sameness, and low-traffic problems. Use when the user wants social content topic ideas, does 选题 / 选题策划 / 爆款标题, plans a content calendar, or needs headline directions for a niche account. Trigger keywords: social content, topic, 选题, 选题策划, headline, 标题, content planning, 爆款, trending. Requires an API key from wsdsocial.com.
